byPath.*: Decides a return request item by item: the return window by category and customer tier, the restocking fee by condition and fault, the refund and the refund date
byPath.ItemReturn: The window, the checks, the verdict, the restocking fee and the refund of one item
byPath.ReturnDecision: The outcome of the request, the return label fee, the total refund and the date by which the refund is paid
byPath.ReturnItem: One returned order line: category, price paid, quantity, condition, reason and the final sale flag
byPath.ReturnItemFacts: The terms of the policy for one item: days since delivery, seller fault and value
byPath.ReturnRequest: A return request: the request, order and delivery dates, the customer tier, the holidays and the returned items
byPath.ReturnRequestFacts: The number of returned items and their value
byPath.itemVerdict: Combines the checks of one item into ACCEPT, PARTIAL, REJECT or REVIEW, with the reason
byPath.mixedReturnBook: A return of five items with five different verdicts
byPath.restockingFee: The restocking fee rate by category, condition and fault
byPath.returnPolicy: The parameters of the return policy: the defect warranty, the return label fee and the refund time
byPath.returnRefund: Decides a return request and returns the verdict and the refund of every item
byPath.returnWindow: The return window in days by product category and customer tier
